steps.speaker: Lead Warrior
steps.content: Since when did Crag's Nest become a dumping ground for every stray piece of scum? The alliance meeting is right around the corner, and you're not concerned about DisCity rats slipping in?

steps.speaker: Lead Warrior
steps.content: I've heard the rumors. DisCity sent some so-called Peace Ambassador to Fraser to flaunt their victory. Who knows what other vermin slithered in behind her?

steps.speaker: Lead Warrior
steps.content: Hmph. Not satisfied with stirring trouble in Fraser, now they want to infiltrate our meeting to pick at the bones? Think again! DisCity dogs... I'll gut every last one of them who dares show their face!

The lead warrior thrusts his arm upward, sweeping his cloak aside. From his inner arm to his waist coils a lattice of black and gold, a pattern that seethes beneath his skin like something alive. His expression is one of fierce, unsettling pride.

steps.speaker: Lead Warrior
steps.content: The war is not over. We must stay sharp! Our brothers and sisters in Furor sacrificed themselves as blades for the future of the farlands... We must carry the fight! Make DisCity pay for what they've done!
His presence is an immediate threat. Hypatia's hand slips inside her cloak, and behind her back, a blade of solid gold forms silently in her grip.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Now, let's all try to keep our manners, shall we? You're frightening my friend.
Rust steps subtly in front of Hypatia, shielding her from view while masking the shifting of her hands beneath her cloak.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: The lady here is a whiz with gadgets. I know folks who need tech. She provides the brains, I provide the brawn, and I'm counting on her to help me turn a tidy profit.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: If you've got any ideas about harming her, I'm afraid I'd have to take issue with that.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Rael, Rust is an old contact of mine. He's trustworthy. And Ms. Tia here just repaired our Aurum Secretum barrier and saved all our lives. How could they possibly be DisCity spies?

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: Disians are cunning as foxes! Of course it's possible!
Rael's blade cuts through the air, its edge aimed at Rust's throat.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: Look at this "friend" of ours. Desert navigator. Skilled fighter. Traveling repairman with a pretty girl in tow.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: That sand ship outside is yours, isn't it? Last I saw it, the owner was a medic.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Sand ships, you know. They all look the same.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: Yokna, what was he calling himself when you knew him?

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: ...Uh, well... back then he was sort of... a relic hunter, I guess?
A heavy silence falls. Every eye locks on Rust, sharp with suspicion.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Sigh, a man's got to have a few side gigs to get by these days. You really have to cut off an honest guy's livelihood?
Rust's smile doesn't waver, but his hand has already found his weapon.
He tilts his head a fraction, his voice a low thread meant only for Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: When it breaks, run for the entrance. Take any sand ship you can find.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: How could I leave you behind? If we go, we go together.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: What kind of honest man has this many faces? Stop playing ******* games with me!
You all are too wound up, seeing enemies in every shadow. With our defenses fixed, we'll all be spilling less of our own blood, won't we?

Just as tension solidifies into violence, a middle-aged man pushes through the crowd. He plants himself between the two parties, all practiced smiles, and claps Rael on the shoulder, a gesture that looks like scolding but carries affection.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: Jab, what are you playing at?

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: I'd like to take advantage of this gathering to offer my sincere thanks. To everyone, and especially to our two heroic guests from afar! The Aurum Secretum Warriors cut down our foes, and the expert raised our shield. Without you all, none of us would have weathered this storm!

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Look, I've just secured a new shipment of arms from outside. With this hardware in your hands, you'll be unstoppable. You can root out every last spy and turncoat.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: So, as a personal favor to me... ease up a little, would you?
His perfectly calibrated praise does its work. As Rael's stance softens, Jabara seizes the opening, waving an attendant forward without a wasted moment.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Quickly, show our esteemed guests the new stock. And give them the friends-and-family discount; put it on my tab.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: Hmph.
He reads the room with precision, tailoring his words to their deepest interests. In moments, the tension that seemed ready to explode is contained.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Flattery and bribery in one tidy package. A real professional.
Jabara turns to Rust and Hypatia, his expression undimmed, as if the mockery had never been spoken.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Pay him no mind, pay him no mind. The fighting's left him a bit... frayed. You two must be exhausted from your travels. Since you've come all this way, allow me to show you around. Our region may be impoverished, but the vistas are absolutely breathtaking.

Jabara's smile remains fixed, but his gaze keeps slipping toward Hypatia, who stays completely hidden behind Rust's figure. Beside him, Rael gives a low, cold snort and lets the challenge drop, though a flicker of unease toward Jabara betrays itself in his stillness.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Don't worry, he won't make trouble. After all, ninety percent of the farlands' food supply passes through my hands. I am Jabara, just a simple merchant trying to get by. And you must be Ms. Hypatia Campbell? Your esteemed brother, Adelaide, has spoken of you. Meeting you today, I see his praise for your grace and bearing was entirely justified.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...! You know Adelaide?
Noting Hypatia's tension, the man's smile softens into something practiced and placating.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Mr. Adelaide? Everyone knows him. We have occasional business dealings, nothing more.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Please, set your mind at ease. A lady of your stature traveling with discretion must have her reasons. I won't speak of it, and I certainly won't mention anything to your honorable brother. It's simply that I've long held the Campbell name in the highest regard and couldn't pass up the chance to make your acquaintance.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Mira

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: These noble families have rules for everything. If she were discovered and hauled back, it'd be weeks confined to some three-story manor, minimum.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: I understand completely. I wouldn't dream of disrupting Ms. Campbell's private excursion.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: I would only ask that, when your journey concludes, you must convey my humble regards to Mr. Adelaide.
The merchant then releases a heavy sigh, a deep frown creasing his brow as he shakes his head repeatedly.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Times are hard, I tell you. The calamities grow worse. Several settlements have exhausted their Aurum Secretum and Hypercube reserves, forcing relocations. Then, during migration, they were caught in the Tide of Ashes... lost a devastating amount of supplies...

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Food is becoming scarce. To protect themselves, some settlements have even closed their gates to outsiders entirely.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: What's the word from Fraser? Are they sending any aid?

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Ever since the Black Ring, communications have been a nightmare. No news, no broadcasts get through. It's been an age since I had any reliable word from Fraser. I wonder, Ms. Campbell, since you've come from that direction... might you have any insight into the situation there?
As he speaks, his eyes dart toward Hypatia once again.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: The Senate's post-war maneuvering, for instance... Take this "Unity Gala" invitation. Anyone with sense knows it's political theater. The highborns must already have their desired outcomes scripted. Why not tip us off in advance? Then we could... align our steps accordingly.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Ah... I see, I understand completely. Your eyes tell me everything. I was hoping Ms. Hypatia might help me discuss a small matter with Mr. Adelaide... You see, I have a surplus of food stores, but the cost of transport is prohibitive. I was considering a modest price adjustment... perhaps an increase of twenty percent...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Transport it out? But the people here don't even—

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Nngh!

steps.speaker: Whispers
steps.content: Disgusting... So disgusting... Die... Campbells... All of you deserve to die...!
A sudden, splitting pain lances through the back of her neck as whispers coil around her thoughts. It's the mental sorcery, triggered without warning.

Memories flood in: the glittering galas, the smiling toasts, the courteous handshakes. Behind the elegant laughter, certain faces were quietly marked as necessary "sacrifices," collateral damage for a greater game.
Hypatia lurches forward violently. The teacup in front of her no longer holds tea, but a swirl of bloody tears. She claps a hand over her mouth, choking back sound.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Ms. Campbell...?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Ah, our journey was rather rough—sandstorms, contamination zones. The young lady is suffering from travel sickness, and I'm afraid this confined space is only aggravating it.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Oh, how careless of me! Please, step outside for some fresh air at once!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: We've been traveling a long while. Your family must be worried. This is a good opportunity to let her know you're safe.
Hypatia nods, offers a polite apology, and rises to leave.
[Scene Change]
In a quiet corner, she doubles over, retching up bile. After a few ragged coughs, she feebly draws out the little bird.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ms. Margaret, Mr. Rust and I have successfully arrived at the farland meeting site and have made contact with the leaders.
The little bird nuzzles against her palm, then a gentle female voice comes through.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hypatia... your voice... what's wrong?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I've found that even among the farlanders themselves, opinions on the current crisis are deeply divided. Their leaders are in constant dispute, each pursuing their own agenda.
She quickly summarizes the situation at the settlement.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: There is even someone who profits by undermining the collective. Should I expose him? Could this be some form of necessary balance I don't understand? Or... is it simply an unavoidable compromise?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: A person's everyday words reveal their true priorities. You are perceptive, Hypatia. With a little focus, you can discern the genuine desires behind their speech. Learn to listen for and understand these subtleties.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: The people of the farlands prioritize concrete gains... because without that focus, they could not have survived the calamities. This may be hard for you to accept, but stating your position, showing where your loyalties lie, establishing mutual benefit... these, too, are the foundations of building trust...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: But most of all, trust in your own capabilities. You need not descend to their level. An Aurum Secretum prodigy should operate by her own rules... your talents... can become their... hope...
Just before the voice fades completely, she asks the question that has been burning inside her.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Why... why can some people simply not see the suffering of others?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: ...Some simply lack the capacity for empathy. But more often... it is because they have not yet left the safety of the shore.
The signal frays, the bird's voice fading into static. Just as silence settles, she hears the measured tread of footsteps behind her.
Hello, Ms. Campbell. What a pleasant coincidence, meeting you here.
